itens.titulo: CVE-2026-132165: Drupal Core Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
itens.resumo: Drupal Core contains a not failing securely vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to take over an existing site or execute arbitrary code via the Drupal installer. Under specific conditions, the attacker can use install.php to attempt to reinstall Drupal on the site.

itens.titulo: CVE-2026-132224: Optimizely Web Experimentation External Control of Critical State Data Vulnerability
itens.resumo: Optimizely Web Experimentation contains an external control of critical state data vulnerability in its account signup flow that could allow an attacker to impersonate existing customer users and modify Project JavaScript. Successful exploitation can result in attacker-controlled JavaScript being distributed through Optimizely-hosted assets and executed in browsers visiting affected customer websites.

itens.titulo: CVE-2026-133968: Project MONAI MONAI Label Path Traversal Vulnerability
itens.resumo: Project MONAI MONAI Label contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to write arbitrary files outside the intended datastore directory, potentially resulting in remote code execution.

itens.titulo: CVE-2026-131914: Idunno AntiCsrf Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
itens.resumo: Idunno AntiCsrf contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via object injection. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

itens.titulo: CVE-2026-134624: N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
itens.resumo: N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the LDAP synchronization connection check that allows an authenticated API user to connect to arbitrary internal hosts and ports, determine which are reachable, and send crafted data to internal services.
